title: incrementing a dotted prerelease identifier
issue_text:
`semver.inc` resets the prerelease counter when the identifier contains a dot

I bump prereleases with `semver.inc`, passing a dot-separated identifier so the version keeps its two-part tag. The counter never moves. Whatever number the version is on, it goes back to zero:

```js
const semver = require('semver')
semver.inc('5.2.0-rc.next.3', 'prerelease', 'rc.next')
// got:      5.2.0-rc.next.0
// expected: 5.2.0-rc.next.4
```

If I leave the identifier out, the number goes up as it should:

```js
semver.inc('5.2.0-rc.next.3', 'prerelease') // 5.2.0-rc.next.4
```

The version already has that identifier followed by a counter, so I expected the counter to go up, not restart from zero.
